terminal_record.title: CNP Membership Compilations Have Different Scopes
terminal_record.description_short: Supplied material describes two incomplete CNP membership compilations but does not establish Donald Trump’s membership or role.
terminal_record.description_medium: Supplied material describes one Council for National Policy compilation as listing 1,011 names from 1981–2020 while covering fewer than half of its members, and a separate 2020 directory said to contain 426 names. The different lists are not a combined membership count. The material does not establish Donald Trump’s membership or any Trump action, so this remains an unverified CNP-history draft.
terminal_record.description_long: Supplied material describes two Council for National Policy membership compilations. It says a TrumpFile compilation spans 1981 to 2020 and lists 1,011 names; its compiler reportedly cautions that it covers fewer than half of the council’s members. A separate directory, described as leaked in September 2020, is said to list 426 people. These figures refer to different documents and should not be added or treated as a total membership count. The frozen entry’s January 20, 1981 date does not establish when either list was created or released. The supplied materials do not confirm Donald Trump’s membership, attendance, participation, or a policy action connected to CNP. This draft therefore describes only the supplied list-scope claims and does not assert a Trump-related event. The counts and dates remain unverified, and a dated membership or participation source, or an explicit scope decision to treat this as CNP history, is needed to resolve the hold.
